evidence: log loss +0.0126 (95% interval +0.0013 to +0.0220). The model's probabilities are WORSE than the market's closing probabilities (the interval is above zero).

193 picks, ROI -0.2% (95% interval -11.5% to +10.6%), win rate 59.1% against a break-even 58.6%. Random sides at the same margin match or beat this 27% of the time. Line movement toward the pick after it was made: +0.07 probability points on average (zero means no closing-line value).
How many bets before ROI can be trusted

At the observed spread of results, detecting a true 3% ROI takes about 4,962 bets and a 5% ROI about 1,786; a 1% edge takes 44,650. Closing-line value converges much faster, which is why it is the primary measure.
